# R packages the R test job needs, one per line (blank lines and # comments ignored).
# Single-sourced here because .github/workflows/ci.yml both installs from this
# file and keys its package cache on its hash, so editing the list invalidates
# the cache automatically.
#
# Derived from the library() and pkg:: references in tests/test_*.R and in the
# files those tests source:
#   testthat   tests/test_forecast_engine.R, test_prediction_logger.R,
#              test_backfill_and_provenance.R, test_xgboost_shap_engine.R
#   dplyr      most engines and tools
#   jsonlite   tools/game_details_builder.R, tools/refresh_live_results.R
#   tidyr      tools/qb_injury_features.R
#   stringr    tools/qb_injury_features.R
#   nflreadr   config.R, team_ratings_engine.R, tools/qb_injury_features.R
#              (loaded only; the tests make no network calls)
#   glmnet     tools/ridge_massey_model.R
#   duckdb     logging_utils.R
#   xgboost    xgboost_shap_engine.R
#   nfl4th     build_coaching_dataset.R (4th-down model estimates, NFL_analytics#171).
#              Listed with the CRAN packages it imports that are not already
#              above, including nflfastR (and nflfastR's fastrmodels). The
#              tests do not call nfl4th; it is installed so the builder's
#              requireNamespace() check matches the pipeline machine.
testthat
dplyr
jsonlite
tidyr
stringr
nflreadr
glmnet
duckdb
xgboost
nfl4th
nflfastR
fastrmodels
cli
curl
